target_statement: There exists a symmetric finite-cap potential Gamma and one fixed lambda>0 such that D_Gamma(G;p) >= lambda*v*K_occ(G;p) for every Boolean gate and product bias, equivalently A_{Gamma,lambda}>=0 universally.
corrected_statement: The signed-transfer recursion remains exact, but the fixed-positive-reserve invariant is false for every finite-cap Gamma and every fixed lambda>0. A balanced antipodal two-flip dictator family satisfies K_occ >= (n-8)(I-1), so A_{Gamma,lambda}<0 for n>8+Gamma(1/2)/lambda. This does not refute FEI.

affected_prior_source.scope: conditional end-to-end strategy requiring A_{Gamma,lambda}>=0; exact recursion and Xi_j example remain valid
